description.en: Explore 18 original art-afternoon situations and six selected Barbie film characters: Barbie, Ken, Gloria, President Barbie, Weird Barbie and Allan. All highest ties and complete bilingual guides are free. Unofficial fan edition.

introduction.en: Which Barbie film character do your creative-afternoon choices bring to mind? Imagine a neighbourhood art gathering where you can question a familiar ritual, follow an interest, draw from everyday life, agree a shared plan, reuse a surprising object or welcome an off-theme contribution. This independent fan edition offers 18 original situations and six complete public guides before you start. It selects characters from the 2023 film rather than claiming to classify every Barbie doll, career or story.
introduction.zh: 创作下午的选择会让你想到哪位芭比电影角色？想象一场社区艺术聚会：可以重新想熟悉环节、追随兴趣、从日常找素材、商量共同计划、意外再利用物件，或欢迎主题之外的贡献。本独立同人版有18道原创情境，六份全文开测前即可阅读。选角来自2023年电影，不把所有芭比玩偶、职业或故事都纳入分类。

instructions.en: Think about a small voluntary creative gathering you would enjoy now. Choose one of four responses in every situation, even if none fits perfectly. No answer ranks beauty, intelligence, kindness or gender expression. A character absent from an item is not rejected. Finish all 18 choices before raw counts appear; every highest tie receives a complete guide.
instructions.zh: 想一场现在愿参加的小型自愿创作聚会，每题四选一，即使都不完全贴合。答案不排名美貌、智力、善良或性别表达。当题未出现的角色不算被拒绝。完成18题后才显示原始次数，每个最高并列都有全文。

prompt.en: Your neighbourhood is holding a voluntary art afternoon. What would you enjoy adding?
prompt.zh: 社区举办一场自愿参加的艺术下午，你最想加入什么？

label.en: Ask what an ordinary welcome would look like if we imagined it afresh.
label.zh: 重新想象一次普通的欢迎，看看还可以是什么样子。

label.en: Pick a small activity because it interests me, even if my friends choose another.
label.zh: 选一项自己感兴趣的小活动，即使朋友选了别的。

label.en: Turn an everyday detail from my own week into a short creative prompt.
label.zh: 把自己这周的日常细节变成一个创作提示。

label.en: Help everyone agree how to use the shared space and time.
label.zh: 帮助大家商量共用空间和时间的安排。

prompt.en: Several friends choose the same workshop, but another table catches your interest. What appeals most?
prompt.zh: 朋友都选了同一个工作坊，另一张桌子却吸引你，什么最合心意？

label.en: Try the table I actually want to explore and catch up with friends later.
label.zh: 先试自己确实想探索的那桌，之后再与朋友碰面。

label.en: Use a small moment from arriving here as material for a tiny sketch.
label.zh: 把刚到这里的一个小片刻画成速写。

label.en: Ask whether the two tables can share their allotted space fairly.
label.zh: 问两桌能否把分到的空间安排得更合适。

label.en: See whether leftover materials can become an unexpected new activity.
label.zh: 看看剩下的材料能不能变成意外的新玩法。

prompt.en: A shared notebook needs an opening page. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 共享创作本需要一个开篇，你更愿意怎样做？

label.en: Start with an ordinary observation from my own day and build from it.
label.zh: 从自己今天的一次普通观察出发，慢慢展开。

label.en: Invite contributors to agree whose pages appear in which order.
label.zh: 邀请参与者一起商量页面的排列顺序。

label.en: Make an unusual opening from scraps that were going to be set aside.
label.zh: 用原本准备放到一边的边角料做一个特别的开篇。

label.en: Leave an inviting place for a contribution that does not fit the main theme.
label.zh: 留一个友好的位置，给不太符合主主题的作品。

prompt.en: Two activities want the same corner for part of the afternoon. What appeals most?
prompt.zh: 两项活动都想在下午的一段时间使用同一个角落，什么最合心意？

label.en: Help the participants agree a simple timetable they can both change.
label.zh: 帮助双方商量一个都能修改的简单时间表。

label.en: Use spare objects to invent a different sort of corner elsewhere.
label.zh: 用闲置物品在别处做出另一种角落。

label.en: Find a way for a small off-theme contribution to remain welcome too.
label.zh: 也让一份偏离主题的小作品有地方被欢迎。

label.en: Ask whether the original idea of what this corner is for still suits us.
label.zh: 问一问，这个角落原先的用途还适不适合大家。

prompt.en: A box of odd shapes is left over from earlier crafts. What would you enjoy?
prompt.zh: 之前的手工留下了一盒形状各异的材料，你喜欢怎样处理？

label.en: Combine two unlikely pieces into an entirely new little object.
label.zh: 把两块看似不搭的材料组合成一个全新的小物件。

label.en: Make room for someone who wants to contribute just one unusual piece.
label.zh: 给只想贡献一块特别材料的人留出位置。

label.en: Reconsider what a finished object has to look like in this activity.
label.zh: 重新想想，这次活动的成品一定要是什么样子。

label.en: Choose a piece I like without needing the group to like the same one.
label.zh: 选自己喜欢的一块，不必等大家都喜欢同一块。

prompt.en: Someone brings a tiny piece that does not match the exhibition theme. What appeals most?
prompt.zh: 有人带来一件不太符合展览主题的小作品，什么最合心意？

label.en: Offer an optional place for it without requiring its maker to change it.
label.zh: 给它一个可选的位置，不要求作者先把它改掉。

label.en: Ask whether the theme itself could leave room for a different question.
label.zh: 问主题本身能不能容纳另一个问题。

label.en: Choose the part I want to make, whether or not it resembles the exhibition.
label.zh: 选择自己想做的部分，不论它像不像展览中的其他作品。

label.en: Link the piece to an ordinary detail from my own experience.
label.zh: 从自己的日常经验里找一个细节，与这件作品相连。

prompt.en: The group repeats last year’s welcome ritual by habit. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 大家习惯性地沿用去年的欢迎环节，你更愿意怎样做？

label.en: Ask what we want a welcome to feel like this year before repeating it.
label.zh: 先问今年想让欢迎带来怎样的感受，再决定是否照旧。

label.en: Choose one small role I enjoy rather than copy a friend’s role.
label.zh: 选一个自己喜欢的小角色，不照着朋友的角色来。

label.en: Suggest a prompt based on an ordinary welcome I remember from this week.
label.zh: 用这周记得的一次普通欢迎，提出一个创作提示。

label.en: Help the group agree who wants a turn and how much time to use.
label.zh: 帮助大家商量谁愿意参与、各用多少时间。

prompt.en: A friend hopes you will join their craft, while you are curious about another. What appeals most?
prompt.zh: 朋友希望你参加他们的手工活动，你却好奇另一项，什么最合心意？

label.en: Say which craft I would like to try and arrange another moment together.
label.zh: 说出自己想试哪项，再约一个一起相处的时段。

label.en: Make a tiny piece about the ordinary experience of choosing between plans.
label.zh: 用在两种安排之间选择的日常体验，做一件小作品。

label.en: Help check that both crafts have the time and table space they were promised.
label.zh: 帮忙看看两项活动是否都有原先约好的时间和桌面。

label.en: Propose a playful object that combines the two piles of spare materials.
label.zh: 提议用两边的闲置材料合做一个有趣物件。

prompt.en: You want to add a line to a shared art card. What would you enjoy writing?
prompt.zh: 你想在共创艺术卡上加一句话，最想写什么？

label.en: A small true detail from my own day, without identifying anyone else.
label.zh: 自己这一天里的一个真实小细节，不透露别人的身份。

label.en: A brief invitation for everyone to choose their own contribution time.
label.zh: 简短邀请大家选择自己的参与时段。

label.en: An unexpected connection between two discarded drawings.
label.zh: 两幅被放下的画之间，一个出人意料的联系。

label.en: A welcome for a contribution that is much smaller or stranger than expected.
label.zh: 欢迎一份比预想更小、也更特别的贡献。

prompt.en: The shared wall has more proposed pieces than empty spaces. What appeals most?
prompt.zh: 共享墙面收到的作品比空位多，什么最合心意？

label.en: Ask contributors to agree a rotation that they can revisit together.
label.zh: 请参与者一起商量轮换方式，并保留再调整的机会。

label.en: Turn some spare materials into a different, playful display format.
label.zh: 用闲置材料做一种不同而有趣的展示形式。

label.en: Reserve a modest optional spot for a piece outside the main grouping.
label.zh: 为主要分组之外的一件作品留一个不大的可选位置。

label.en: Question whether every piece needs to be on a wall at all.
label.zh: 想一想，是不是每件作品都必须挂在墙上。

prompt.en: A paper decoration tears in a visually interesting way. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 纸装饰裂开了一个很有意思的形状，你更愿意怎样做？

label.en: Ask its maker whether the tear could become part of a new design.
label.zh: 问作者愿不愿意让裂口成为新设计的一部分。

label.en: Offer space for the altered piece even if it no longer matches the others.
label.zh: 即使它不再像其他作品，也给改变后的它留个位置。

label.en: Ask whether matching the original decoration is still what we want.
label.zh: 问一问，大家现在是否仍想让它与原设计一致。

label.en: Choose the decoration I want to work on without comparing my taste to friends.
label.zh: 选自己想做的装饰，不必拿自己的喜好与朋友比较。

prompt.en: A participant would like to share one small thing and then leave. What appeals most?
prompt.zh: 一位参与者只想分享一小件东西，然后离开，什么最合心意？

label.en: Welcome that limited contribution without asking for a larger performance.
label.zh: 欢迎这份有限的贡献，不要求对方来一场更大的表演。

label.en: Reconsider whether the afternoon needs a single standard for participation.
label.zh: 重新想想，这个下午是否需要一种统一的参与标准。

label.en: Choose my own contribution size based on what I want to do today.
label.zh: 按今天想做多少，选择自己的贡献大小。

label.en: Use a small everyday departure as inspiration for my own drawing.
label.zh: 用一次日常告别给自己的画找灵感。

prompt.en: You are invited to redesign an ordinary invitation for the next art afternoon. What appeals most?
prompt.zh: 你受邀重新设计下一次艺术下午的普通邀请，什么最合心意？

label.en: Ask which familiar assumption about the event we could playfully revisit.
label.zh: 问哪些关于活动的熟悉设定可以重新、有趣地想一想。

label.en: Choose a part of the invitation I want to make in my own style.
label.zh: 选一部分自己想用自己的风格完成的邀请。

label.en: Begin with an ordinary moment that made me want to create something.
label.zh: 从一个曾让我想动手创作的日常片刻开始。

label.en: Help contributors agree what the invitation promises about shared time.
label.zh: 帮助参与者商量邀请中对共用时间作出哪些约定。

prompt.en: There is time for one more optional activity before you go. What would you enjoy?
prompt.zh: 离开前还有时间参加一项可选活动，你最想做什么？

label.en: Try something that interests me even if nobody I came with selects it.
label.zh: 试自己感兴趣的内容，即使同行的人都没有选它。

label.en: Make a quick piece from one ordinary detail I noticed on the way here.
label.zh: 用来这里路上注意到的一个普通细节做一件小作品。

label.en: Help settle a short, changeable turn-taking plan for the remaining time.
label.zh: 帮忙为剩余时间商量一个简短、可调整的轮流安排。

label.en: Transform a few unwanted scraps into something nobody planned.
label.zh: 把几片不再需要的材料变成原计划之外的东西。

prompt.en: The group suggests a final shared picture about the afternoon. What appeals most?
prompt.zh: 大家提议合做一幅关于这个下午的画，什么最合心意？

label.en: Add an everyday moment I experienced myself rather than a grand message.
label.zh: 画一个自己经历的日常片刻，不一定要表达宏大主题。

label.en: Ask everyone which section they would like and agree a loose order.
label.zh: 问大家想画哪部分，再商量一个大致顺序。

label.en: Make a playful feature out of the shapes the others have left over.
label.zh: 把别人画完后留下的形状变成一个有趣细节。

label.en: Keep a welcoming place for a small contribution beyond the picture’s main idea.
label.zh: 给主构想之外的一点小贡献留一个友好的位置。

prompt.en: You are discussing how a future shared art session could work. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 讨论未来的共创艺术活动时，你更愿意怎样做？

label.en: Help willing participants agree a few clear arrangements they can revise.
label.zh: 帮助愿意参加的人约定几个清楚、可修改的安排。

label.en: Suggest a session built around finding new uses for overlooked materials.
label.zh: 提议用一场活动，探索被忽略材料的新用途。

label.en: Allow small off-theme contributions without making their makers explain themselves.
label.zh: 容纳偏离主题的小贡献，不要求作者先为自己辩解。

label.en: Ask what we are assuming an art session has to be.
label.zh: 问一问，我们预设的艺术活动一定得是什么样。

prompt.en: Two leftover items seem to belong to different projects. What appeals most?
prompt.zh: 两件剩余物看起来属于完全不同的项目，什么最合心意？

label.en: Try a surprising combination with the makers’ permission.
label.zh: 得到作者同意后，试一次意外的组合。

label.en: Make a little place where either item can appear without fitting a category.
label.zh: 留一个小位置，让任何一件都能出现，不必硬归类。

label.en: Ask whether the categories are still useful for this afternoon.
label.zh: 问这些分类对这个下午是否仍有用。

label.en: Pick whichever item I want to explore, independently of the most popular choice.
label.zh: 不跟着最热门的选择，挑自己想探索的那件。

prompt.en: A future participant asks whether their unusual little project belongs here. What would you enjoy doing?
prompt.zh: 一位未来的参与者问，自己的特别小项目能否放在这里，你喜欢怎样回应？

label.en: Offer a clear, optional welcome without promising the whole group will copy it.
label.zh: 清楚地欢迎对方自由参与，不承诺全组都要照着做。

label.en: Ask whether our idea of belonging could be wider than the current theme.
label.zh: 问我们的接纳范围能否比当前主题宽一点。

label.en: Choose what I would like to contribute while respecting their different choice.
label.zh: 在尊重对方不同选择的同时，决定自己想贡献什么。

label.en: Find an ordinary detail from my own life that helps me respond creatively.
label.zh: 从自己的日常生活里找一个细节，给出有创意的回应。

title.en: The Barbie angle in this edition

paragraphs.en: Barbie names the angle of looking again at something so familiar that nobody has asked about it recently. In this original art afternoon, you might wonder what a welcome is meant to offer rather than repeat last year’s ritual automatically. The pleasure is discovering a different possibility inside an ordinary activity. It need not involve a dramatic reinvention, a perfect appearance or a decision about how your whole life should look.
paragraphs.zh: 芭比在本版对应重新审视熟悉事物的角度：有些安排太常见，大家很久没有问过为什么。在原创艺术下午里，你可能先想欢迎环节想带来什么，而不是自动重复去年的流程。乐趣是从普通活动里发现另一种可能，不必大改人生，也不要求完美外貌。

title.en: An invitation that asks a fresh question
title.zh: 让邀请多问一个新问题

paragraphs.en: The group is about to reuse a familiar invitation. You ask whether it tells newcomers they can bring a tiny unfinished experiment as well as a polished piece. That question changes what the invitation makes possible without declaring the earlier version wrong. Someone else may still enjoy the old format. The useful move is opening one assumption for discussion and listening to what contributors actually want to keep.
paragraphs.zh: 大家正准备沿用熟悉的邀请。你问，能不能也告诉新朋友：小小的未完成试验也可以带来，不必只带完整作品。这给邀请增加了可能性，不等于旧版本做错了。别人仍可以喜欢原形式；有用的动作是把一个预设拿出来讨论，再听大家真正想保留什么。

title.en: Curiosity beside five other contributions

paragraphs.en: Ken chooses an interest of his own, Gloria starts from everyday experience and President Barbie helps agree shared arrangements. Weird Barbie tries an unexpected reuse, while Allan welcomes a contribution outside the main grouping. Barbie asks which familiar assumption can be revisited. These actions can work together: a new question may need a practical agreement or an ordinary example before it becomes enjoyable. Several high counts offer several readings, without ranking originality or confidence.
paragraphs.zh: 肯选择自己的兴趣，格洛丽亚从日常经验出发，总统芭比帮助商量共同安排；怪芭比尝试意外再利用，艾伦欢迎主要分组之外的贡献。芭比则问熟悉预设能否重想。新问题也可能需要实际约定或日常例子才能变得有趣。几项高次数可以一起读，不给原创性或自信排名。

title.en: A fresh question can wait

paragraphs.en: Questioning every small convention can consume an afternoon people wanted to spend making things. Ask which assumption matters now and leave the rest alone if the group prefers. A familiar ritual can be comforting and still remain optional. Your count cannot establish exceptional curiosity or dissatisfaction with your life, and a lower count does not mean you lack imagination. Sometimes keeping the usual welcome is exactly what participants want.
paragraphs.zh: 如果每个小习惯都要重新讨论，大家原本想动手的下午也会过去。可以先问哪一个预设现在最值得谈，其余暂时放下。熟悉环节可以让人舒服，也可以保持可选。次数不证明超常好奇或对人生不满；较低次数也不等于缺想象。有时大家就是想保留原来的欢迎。

title.en: Try one editable assumption

paragraphs.en: Choose an optional creative activity and write down one assumption about how it should begin. Ask a willing collaborator whether another beginning would be enjoyable, then try a small version of either option. Afterwards, compare what the two openings allowed you to notice. You can keep the familiar approach. The experiment concerns a particular activity, rather than proving courage, discovering a hidden identity or prescribing a major personal transformation.
paragraphs.zh: 选一项可选创作活动，写下关于开场的一个预设。问愿意合作的人，换一种开场会不会有趣，再小范围试一种或两种。之后比较各自让你注意到了什么，也可以留下熟悉做法。这只探索一项活动，不证明勇气、不揭示隐藏身份，也不要求重大转变。

title.en: Original fan edition and source limits
title.zh: 原创同人版与来源边界

paragraphs.en: FermatMind independently authored this unofficial fan edition: original community-art situations, mappings, examples and complete readings. title.en: The Ken angle in this edition

paragraphs.en: Ken anchors choosing a small activity because it interests you, even when companions prefer another table. You can enjoy a friend’s company and still spend part of an afternoon differently. The important detail is recognising what you want to try now without needing it to be the most popular or impressive option.

title.en: The Gloria angle in this edition

It starts with something you noticed and asks what you would enjoy making from it in this small shared setting.

title.en: A waiting moment becomes a tiny drawing

paragraphs.en: You remember a patch of afternoon light while waiting for a friend. You make a small drawing about its shape rather than describe the friend’s private circumstances. The everyday starting point offers material without claiming that the drawing reveals your feelings completely, explains another person or has to become a lesson for the whole group.

title.en: Your experience can remain yours

paragraphs.en: A shared activity can invite more explanation than you want to offer. You can use a neutral detail, invent something entirely or keep a piece private. A small drawing does not need an autobiographical account to deserve a place. Your count cannot establish emotional insight, caregiving capacity or parental identity, and a lower count does not mean your ordinary life lacks richness or that you are unable to make meaningful work.

The exercise explores a creative starting point, not emotional diagnosis, a test of empathy or an obligation to make personal experience useful to others.

title.en: The President Barbie angle in this edition

paragraphs.en: President Barbie anchors making a few shared arrangements with the people who will use them. At the art afternoon, that might mean agreeing a turn-taking plan for one crowded table. The angle is about a voluntary, changeable agreement, not authority attached to a title. A useful arrangement makes participation easier to understand while allowing contributors to question it, choose a smaller part or leave an optional activity without being judged.
paragraphs.zh: 总统芭比在本版对应与使用安排的人一起商量几项共同约定。在艺术下午里，也许是给一张拥挤桌子约定轮流方式。角度关乎自愿、可变的协议，不是头衔带来的权威。有用安排让参与更清楚，同时容许提问、选择小份任务，或离开可选活动而不受评判。

title.en: One corner, two enjoyable activities

paragraphs.en: Two groups want the same corner, and both can explain what they hoped to make there. You help put those needs into a short timetable and ask whether the proposed order works. The timetable remains editable when someone arrives late or wants less time. The contribution is helping this particular afternoon run, not deciding that the loudest group deserves the space or requiring anyone to accept your first solution.
paragraphs.zh: 两组都想用同一个角落，也都能说清想在那里做什么。你帮忙把需要放进一个短时间表，再问顺序是否合适。有人迟到或只想少用一会时，时间表仍可改。贡献是让这个下午好进行，不是判最响亮的一组应该得地盘，也不要求接受你的第一个方案。

paragraphs.en: Barbie rethinks a familiar assumption, Ken chooses an interest and Gloria offers an everyday starting point. Weird Barbie finds a surprising reuse, while Allan leaves room for an unusual small contribution. President Barbie helps those activities share time and space. An agreement can protect differences rather than erase them. Several high counts do not establish political ability, leadership quality or a duty to take charge of every gathering you attend.
paragraphs.zh: 芭比重想熟悉预设，肯选兴趣，格洛丽亚给日常起点；怪芭比找到意外再利用，艾伦给特别的小贡献留位置。总统芭比帮助这些活动共用时间和空间。约定可以保护不同，而非抹平不同。几项高次数不证明政治能力、领导水平，也不要求在每次聚会都负责。

title.en: A plan can be smaller than the event
title.zh: 安排可以比活动更简单

paragraphs.en: Not every small choice needs a meeting or a rule. Ask which shared resource actually needs an agreement and leave individual preferences alone. You can also decline the coordinating role if you wanted to spend the afternoon making something. Your count cannot establish authority, fairness or political beliefs, and a lower count does not mean you are unable to cooperate. Sometimes a single clear time boundary is enough for everyone to get started.
paragraphs.zh: 不是每个小选择都需要会议或规则。可以问哪项共享资源真需要约定，其余个人偏好留给个人。若本想来创作，也能不接协调角色。次数不确立权威、公平或政治信念；较低次数不表示不能合作。有时一个清楚的时间边界就够大家开工。

paragraphs.en: For a voluntary creative session, identify one resource that participants want to share and ask each willing person what would make it workable.
